# Constructing R-matrices {#sec-r-matrices}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false title="Learning goals"}
- Solve Jimbo's intertwining equations for a trigonometric R-matrix.
- Use the tensor-product graph and recognise when it fails.
- Construct R-matrices directly when tensor products are not multiplicity-free.
- Build new R-matrices by fusion.
- Pass from the vertex to the IRF (RSOS) form of an R-matrix.
:::
